title: About — SANRUSAN
description: SANRUSAN, a gallery for collectible design on Strada Zăgazului, Bucharest.
label: About
statement_lead: A gallery for functional art in Bucharest.
statement_dim: Objects that can be used, and deserve to be looked at.
columns: SANRUSAN opens in 2026 on Strada Zăgazului, in the north of Bucharest. It is a gallery for collectible design: furniture, lighting and sculptural objects made by hand, in editions or as unique pieces, where design and art meet.

The gallery shows one body of work at a time and gives it the whole space, long enough for the work to be seen properly. It opens with Transparency Matters, a solo presentation by Draga & Aurel, the Como studio of Draga Obradovic and Aurel K. Basedow.
